intro: Restaurants are part of a normal life. The skill is honest logging and a few defaults — not avoiding every invitation.
buddyTip: Decide your protein order first, then build sides. Invisible oils are expected — estimate them instead of logging a fantasy grilled-only plate.
mission: At your next restaurant meal, pick a protein-forward main, enjoy it, and log it the same day with a fair fat estimate.
why: Social meals sustain relationships — and relationships sustain habits. A plan that forbids restaurants usually fails the first birthday dinner.
Restaurant calories are uncertain. Coaching aims for directional honesty: protein source, rough carbs, and a non-zero fat assumption beat precise fiction.
One restaurant meal rarely breaks a week. A weekend of unlogged feasts plus Monday punishment might.

points: Scan the menu for a clear protein centre
Ask for dressings and sauces on the side when it helps you
Share large sides or box half if portions are huge
Voice-log at the table or right after: “salmon, potatoes, butter sauce, wine”

misconceptions.myth: If I can’t know exact grams, I shouldn’t log.
misconceptions.truth: A fair estimate keeps Progress usable. Silence creates bigger errors.

misconceptions.myth: Salad is always the low-calorie choice.
misconceptions.truth: Cheese, candied nuts, and creamy dressing can exceed a simple hot protein plate.

how.lead: Use a short pre-game, then enjoy the people.
steps: Preview the menu if possible; choose a default protein dish category
Eat a normal protein-aware day around the meal — don’t “save” all calories and arrive ravenous
Order intentionally; skip the guilt narration at the table
Log with Buddy (voice is ideal) including oils/sauces/drinks
Return to your usual plan at the next meal — no compensatory starve
how.buddyHelps: Voice and camera capture messy real-world meals quickly. Foodiary lets you refine later if you learn more about the dish.

sections.title: Cuisine-specific defaults
paras: Grill/fish houses: protein + potato + vegetable, watch butter sauces.
Pizza: add a protein side salad, decide slice count in advance, log oil-rich reality.
Buffets: one plate strategy — protein and plants first.

sections.title: Business lunches
paras: Default to water or one drink; keep afternoon work in mind. Logging afterward matters more than performing restriction in front of colleagues.

mistakes.quote: I logged grilled chicken breast with zero oil because I scraped the sauce.
mistakes.why: Cooking fat remains. Add a modest oil estimate.

mistakes.quote: I skipped logging so I wouldn’t see the damage.
mistakes.why: Avoidance blocks learning. Honest ugly logs are brave and useful.

mistakes.quote: I punished yesterday’s dinner with no food until 6pm.
mistakes.why: Compensation increases the next overeat. Resume normal structure.

encouragement: Belonging and food can coexist. Order like an adult, log like a scientist, and rejoin your routine at the next meal.
